## Checklist for a new plugin

- [ ] This pull request adds one plugin using the table row format.
- [ ] I chose a category, including a notification subsection where applicable, or proposed a new category in this pull request.
- [ ] Official entries stay first, with official and community entries each in alphabetical order by plugin name within the category.
- [ ] The GitHub repository is public and includes the plugin's source code.
- [ ] The plugin is built from or compatible with the Among plugin template and can be installed by Among.
- [ ] At least one stable release is published; the latest stable release is immutable and includes `among-plugins.json` and matching package assets in the template's release format.
- [ ] The plugin repository has a licence file.
- [ ] The plugin README explains what it shows or does and its required and optional access.
